page_title: LEN 0-4 AUX | Lens v Auxerre 27/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Theo Bair (Auxerre) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His effort goes inches wide of the left post.
90+5' A clumsy foul by Wesley Said (Lens) and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle.
90+3' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
90+2' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90+2' The ball is cleared after Jeremy Agbonifo (Lens) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Corner kick. Lens will have an opportunity.
90+1' The referee gives a yellow card to Eros Maddy (Auxerre).
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Florian Aye (Auxerre) picks up a long through ball, but Mathew Ryan deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
88' Anass Zaroury goes off the pitch and Tom Pouilly (Lens) comes on.
87' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) is penalised for holding. Mathieu Vernice signals a set piece.
86' Florian Sotoca (Lens) makes a horror tackle on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
85' The game has come to an end for Jubal Junior. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Eros Maddy (Auxerre).
84' Here is a change. Ki-Jana Hoever is going off and Christophe Pelissier gives the last tactical orders to Paul Joly (Auxerre).
83' Anass Zaroury sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Angelo Fulgini (Lens), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
83' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Lens earn a corner.
83' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lens.
83' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ruben Aguilar (Lens) was quite harsh and Mathieu Vernice didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' Jeremy Agbonifo (Lens) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) replaces Han-Noah Massengo.
75' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) gets booked for the first time in this match.
74' Christophe Pelissier prepares a substitution. Ado Onaiwu is replaced by Theo Bair (Auxerre).
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Florian Aye (Auxerre) will replace Lassine Sinayoko.
73' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Goduine Koyalipou as he is replaced by Wesley Said (Lens).

73' 0 - 4 Stunning strike! Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) latches on to a precise through ball from Gaetan Perrin before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 0:4.
71' Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.

69' Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Donovan Leon shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
69' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
67' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
66' Jeremy Agbonifo (Lens) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
65' Anass Zaroury (Lens) takes the corner kick, but Donovan Leon reads it well and stops the effort.
65' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Lens win a corner.

64' Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post.
63' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
61' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Goduine Koyalipou (Lens), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
60' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ruben Aguilar (Lens) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
59' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
58' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
55' The substitution is prepared. Florian Sotoca (Lens) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Neil El Aynaoui.
55' Jeremy Agbonifo (Lens) has tested the patience of referee Mathieu Vernice and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
53' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the right post.
52' The referee is firm and issues Donovan Leon (Auxerre) a deserved yellow card.
52' An attempted cross from Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is cleared.
51' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Anass Zaroury (Lens), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
50' Lens have been awarded a free kick.
50' Han-Noah Massengo (Auxerre) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
49' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Neil El Aynaoui (Lens). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

48' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out. The ball goes out for a corner. Lens can continue in their attacking effort.
48' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
47' Half-time substitution. Malang Sarr (Lens) is replaced by Jeremy Agbonifo.
46' Will Still makes a switch. Angelo Fulgini is coming on in place of Andy Diouf (Lens) at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Referee Mathieu Vernice sees the trip by Assane Diousse (Auxerre) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.

44' 0 - 3 Goal! Great link up play between Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre) and Lassine Sinayoko gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom right corner. 0:3.
43' Abdulay Juma Bah (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mathieu Vernice had an easy-decision to make.
43' Lovely run from Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
40' 0 - 2 Lassine Sinayoko passes to Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre), who gets one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy grounds the keeper and he has a simple task lifting the ball over him into the net.
40' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre), but the defence gets it clear.

39' Anass Zaroury (Lens) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Donovan Leon has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save.
38' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
36' Andy Diouf (Lens) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
34' 0 - 1 Goal! Lassine Sinayoko gets to the ball, slips Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 0:1.
31' The cross into the penalty area from Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
29' Anass Zaroury (Lens) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
28' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
28' A crossfield pass from Abdulay Juma Bah (Lens) fails to find any of his teammates.
26' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
25' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Assane Diousse (Auxerre). Mathieu Vernice saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
24' A dangerous looking corner kick from Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is cleared to safety by the defence.
24' Lens failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Good work from Lens as they win a corner.

23' He should have scored! Anass Zaroury (Lens) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Donovan Leon makes an easy save. The ball is out of play and Lens manage to earn a corner.
21' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
21' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Mathew Ryan comes off the line to clear the ball away.

20' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Mathieu Vernice blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
19' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Donovan Leon intercepts the ball.
17' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the left-hand post.
15' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
12' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
11' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lens comes to nothing.
10' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Ruben Aguilar, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Lens.
9' Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
8' Anass Zaroury (Lens) sends a cross into the box, but Donovan Leon comes off his line to gather the ball.
6' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) was waiting for the ball on the penalty spot and produced a powerful volley goalwards, but the goalkeeper made an amazing save to deny him.
6' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
4' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle after Anass Zaroury (Lens) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
3' Deiver Machado (Lens) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lens.
1' Deiver Machado (Lens) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Lens will have the kick-off.
Mathieu Vernice is the one to supervise the game today.
